macos.rationale: QM Desktop 0.1.6 is offered for Apple Silicon Macs. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

windows.rationale: The complete published Desktop 0.1.6 assets contain only the Apple Silicon Mac client. Local prototype packaging and shortcuts are not a shipped windows desktop release.

linux.rationale: The complete published Desktop 0.1.6 assets contain only the Apple Silicon Mac client. Local prototype packaging and shortcuts are not a shipped linux desktop release.

web-client.rationale: Web workspace. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

cli.rationale: Deployment CLI is separate from chat actions. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

pi.rationale: Current QM architecture names Pi as its agent loop. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

claude-code.rationale: The active product loop is Pi and has no client-selectable adapter for this coding-agent CLI. Model/provider access, installed sandbox commands and generic execution are separate.

own-server.rationale: Organization deployment. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

local.rationale: The local Docker sandbox provider runs tools on the operator computer. The standalone Mac desktop app itself still connects to an existing core.

parallel-runs.rationale: Worker sessions with separate durable transcripts. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

coordinator.rationale: Swarms expose identities, model settings, messages and retained results. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Crons. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

roles.rationale: Admin controls organization configuration and sharing. Full role matrix unverified. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

license.rationale: MIT, subject to component notices. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

self-hosting.rationale: Operator cloud deployment. Scope: QM web workspace, QM Slack plugin, QM core and deployment CLI, QM Desktop Apple Silicon.

mobile-web.rationale: Documented phone layout and PWA access use same web UI, including composer and approvals.

ios.rationale: Bounded inspection of the public client source/release inventory finds web/PWA phone access but no native phone app.

android.rationale: Bounded inspection of the public client source/release inventory finds web/PWA phone access but no native phone app.

multiplayer.rationale: README explicitly describes employees collaborating with the agent in shared channels, group messages and projects.

pr-workflow.rationale: README explicitly lists working in repositories to open PRs and monitor CI; not a completed PR test.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Deployment operator can omit PostHog/browser Sentry keys; backend Sentry DSN is a separate optional switch documented in the finding.

vm.rationale: DigitalOcean Managed Agents provider uses a microVM template; provider-specific option, not every sandbox backend.

worktree.rationale: The current scoped-computer backend has no product-managed Git worktree option; an agent can still run generic Git commands.

container.rationale: The local sandbox provider provisions per-scope Docker containers, home volumes and separate networks. This is not a claim of one container per task.

sso.rationale: Own-cloud deployment supports external OIDC sign-in through its documented SSO front door; no SAML or hosted enterprise-plan inference.

free-plan.rationale: The first-party application distribution is free MIT software without a published YC paid tier. Operator cloud and model charges and third-party hosting plans are separate.

subscription.rationale: The first-party application distribution is free MIT software without a published YC paid tier. Operator cloud and model charges and third-party hosting plans are separate.

usage-based.rationale: The first-party application distribution is free MIT software without a published YC paid tier. Operator cloud and model charges and third-party hosting plans are separate.

compute.rationale: The first-party application distribution is free MIT software without a published YC paid tier. Operator cloud and model charges and third-party hosting plans are separate.

one-time.rationale: The first-party application distribution is free MIT software without a published YC paid tier. Operator cloud and model charges and third-party hosting plans are separate.

free-tier.rationale: MIT-licensed software, free to deploy; no QM price stated. Cloud and model costs separate. Scope: self-deployed QM.

starting-price.rationale: No QM paid plan is published; the software is free under MIT. Own cloud and model costs excluded. Scope: self-deployed QM.

byo-subscription.rationale: The first-party Personal AI accounts guide explicitly supports Claude and ChatGPT/Codex subscription sign-in through native OAuth for human turns. The loop remains Pi.

review-ui.rationale: Bounded inspection of the current client and API found file/artifact viewers and approvals, without a proposed-code diff review surface.

issue-tracking.rationale: The current public API and UI expose sessions/runs, schedules and approvals rather than an independent native issue tracker.

laptop-independent.rationale: The documented operator-cloud headless core owns persistent agents and background schedules independently of the browser/desktop client. The operator must keep the host running.
